this world mission sunday marks the 100th anniversary of its establishment by pope pius xi in 1926. this centenary is an opportunity to celebrate with renewed missionary zeal. last year, pope leo xiv made an appeal to us in a personal video for world mission sunday. his request echoed around the world: “please help me help missionaries everywhere.” that’s what world mission sunday does: it helps pope leo care for the 1,130 missionary dioceses and territories under his supervision through the dicastery for evangelization. we are all called to be a part of this missionary work and we have a singular means to do so: world mission sunday. the world mission sunday envelope collection helps extend the church’s evangelization work to missionary lands where the gospel is being proclaimed for the first time, as well as to places where t he church barely exists, or is too young, too persecuted, or too poor to sustain herself. than k you for responding to pope leo’s call to help him help missionaries everywhere! celebrating the sacrament of baptism: with great joy we welcome baby amelia into the church of god. may the lord bless her abundantly, and may her parents, godparents, & family be strengthened as they nurture her in the faith & love of jesus christ. parish collections : last weekend – parish (including dromin patrun) €4,035 ; dues € 325; st patrick’s cathedral restoration fund €5. sincere thanks for your ongoing support. chy tax relief forms: are being been posted out in these weeks. these are a valuable source of income for the parish. thank you to all those who complete and return their forms. annual mass of remembrance: for our parish will be celebrated in st. brigid’s church, dunleer on friday november 27th at 7.30pm. parish list of the dead: lists & envelopes are now available in our churches & parish office. these can be returned via the mass collection, to the sacristy or to the parochial house ideally by friday october 30th. mass is celebrated on each first friday throughout the year for all those on the parish list of the dead. please note there is no requirement to include a monetary donation in the envelopes. rosary in mosstown cemetery: every saturday for the month of november at 3pm - all are welcome. pope’s intention for october: for mental health ministry, asking the church to establish and support these services to help overcome the stigma and discrimination faced by people with mental illness dunleer
